name: @lattice/example-errand
description: ERRAND — a gallery exhibit. An RPG in an afternoon: walk, talk, take, use, save.
$comment: Seven of nine. @lattice/sim is absent because an errand has no economy — there is no number the player is playing for, which is precisely what the five-verb rule protects. @lattice/audio is absent for the reason island reported: the gallery still has no shared answer for the unlock gesture, and a page that makes noise before it is touched is worse than a silent one. Everything else is here by name, and this is the first exhibit to hold `persist` and `ui` at the same time: a dialog box, a HUD that says when the save wrote, and a reload that puts the player back where they were.
